h: Where this one sits in Grimsby
p: This branch sits further along Victoria Street from its daytime sibling, still within easy walking distance of Freshney Place, the bus station and Grimsby Town station.

It's an adults-only gaming centre, so it's 18+ and no place for the kids. The town centre around it has the usual mix of high street chains, cafés and takeaways, and Grimsby is famous for its fish, so it would be rude not to grab fish and chips while you're here. Make time for the Fishing Heritage Centre down on Alexandra Dock if you've never been, as it's a cracking way to understand the town. And if you've got the family in tow, Cleethorpes is just next door, with the seafront, the pier and plenty of traditional amusements for all ages.
